title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive
Forest of Dean
£35,000 per annum

Enjoy opening doors, building relationships and winning new business?

Autograph Recruitment is looking for a Business Development Executive to join our client in the Forest of Dean.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys getting on the phone, starting conversations and turning an initial enquiry into a lasting business relationship. You ll take an active role in finding new opportunities, understanding what customers need and following through to secure their business.

What will you be doing?
- Identifying and approaching potential customers through calls, emails and networking.
- Building relationships with decision-makers and understanding their requirements.
- Presenting the company s offering and preparing tailored proposals.
- Following up on enquiries and quotes to turn opportunities into sales.
- Managing your pipeline and keeping customer records up to date.
- Working closely with colleagues to ensure a smooth handover for new customers.

What are we looking for?

You ll have experience in sales or business development, with the confidence to approach new customers and keep conversations moving.

We re looking for someone who is organised, motivated and comfortable picking up the phone. You ll ask good questions, listen to what customers need and be proactive with your follow-up.

If you enjoy seeing your efforts turn into results and are looking for your next opportunity locally, we d love to hear from you.

Interested? Let s chat.
Apply today or contact Holly at Autograph Recruitment on (phone number removed) or (url removed).

title: Graduate/Graduate Calibre Sales Consultant
description:
Graduate Business Development Consultant OR Graduate Calibre

£27k - £30k basic salary + Realistic uncapped £50k 1st Year On Target Earnings + £5.5k per annum car allowance with fuel card + Private Healthcare + Pension

Operating across 30 countries, this market-leading organisation is a major force in sustainability and recycling. As the largest supplier to the NHS and trusted by household names including Tesco and Sainsbury s, the business is entering an exciting new phase of UK expansion and you could be part of it!

We re looking for bright, vibrant, engaging and determined graduates with the ambition to follow in the footsteps of rising stars such as Jenna Meek, Susie Ma, Ben Francis and Steven Bartlett.

If you re ambitious, confident and ready to make your mark, this is an opportunity to build a successful, rewarding career with a global industry leader. You ll be joining an environment where talented graduates can develop confidence, build commercial skills and progress rapidly into leadership and senior roles.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out
- Top-Tier Training: Industry-leading graduate programme within a company boasting 86% employee satisfaction.
- Proven Career Progression: Four graduates have already been promoted into management positions, showing the genuine opportunity to progress and build a long-term career.
- Real Responsibility: Build your own territory, develop relationships and take ownership of your success.
- Big Impact: Join a global company making waves in sustainability and innovation.
- A Career Without Limits: Your progression is driven by your ambition, performance and ability to make an impact.
- Step into a B2 B sales position where you ll:
- Develop new accounts and drive growth within your own territory.
- Build strong relationships with business owners and decision-makers.
- Receive full support with bespoke training tailored specifically for graduates.
- Develop your commercial confidence and communication skills in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.
- Represent a world-leading company known for its expertise in textile and facilities services.

We re Looking For Ambitious, Driven Candidates Who:
- Are confident, engaging and enjoy connecting with people.
- Want to take control of their earnings and build a stellar professional career.
- Are ready to learn, develop and step outside their comfort zone.
- Thrive in a dynamic, target-focused environment.
- Are hungry for structured professional development and rapid career progression.
- Have the ambition to follow in the footsteps of inspiring young entrepreneurs and business leaders.

What s On Offer:
- Work with a sustainability leader trusted by top brands.
- Industry-leading graduate training and development.
- Fast-track your career in a global corporate environment.
- Competitive earnings, exciting challenges and excellent growth opportunities.
- A supportive, ambitious environment where your success is recognised and rewarded.

You could be the next Jenna Meek, Susie Ma, Ben Francis or Steven Bartlett. but ultimately, we re looking for the next you!

If you re ready to unleash your potential, build your confidence and make your mark with an industry leader, don t wait. Apply now and take the first step towards an exceptional career.

title: Tailor Made Sales Consultant
description:
Position: Tailor Made Sales Consultant (up to Executive

depending on experience or skills-set) Full Time / Part Time
Department: Tailor Made Journeys and/or Agency Sales

Location: Cheltenham, but you may be required to work at such other location(s) as the Company may require

Reports to: FIT Manager

PURPOSE:

Using the client brief and subsequent qualifying process this role involves building and pricing creative luxury tailor-made programs for travel across Europe. The Consultant will be responsible for achieving sales and margin goals, along with designing programs which are operationally sound. Ultimately the aim is to exceed expectations of our guests, sales offices and travel advisors so the return to A&K again and again.

Summary
- To design tailor-made FIT programmes for A&K sales offices or travel advisors, checking the feasibility of itineraries and making suggestions as appropriate.
- Meet or exceed set and agreed turnaround, sales, conversion and margin targets.
- To negotiate better hotel and land provider rates rates where possible
- To cost each programme accurately, competitively and to the required level of quality within the agreed time frame whilst maintaining creativity, using the in-house reservations system
- To actively follow up on all new business quoted until a definitive result is obtained.
- On confirmation, set up the file and ensure the reservation system are accurate before handing over to the operator.
- To actively investigate new products and opportunities to achieve greater sales to existing and new clients.
- To check, when requested, costings and itinerary content of programmes which have been set up by other team members.
- To check the final itinerary and Supplier Information Report before it is sent to all suppliers, as required.
- To built strong relationships with a global clientele of luxury travel industry professionals in order to encourage repeat business.

Quality Control / Customer Service:
- To develop an itinerary which is operationally viable from the outset
- To assist managers and operations staff in handling issues as they arise
- To provide Quality Control information to the Manager/Supervisor as required
- To proactively participate in, and provide training on destinations, products and procedures

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:

Desired Skills-Set:
- A confident, positive attitude
- Strong spoken and written communication skills. A second European language is advantageous
- A Good level of geographical and general knowledge of Europe is advantageous
- Up-to-date knowledge of Outlook, Word, Teams and Excel
- A natural affinity for sales and (over) achieving goals
- A real passion for travel
- Ability to multi-task and work under pressure
- Attention to detail
- A willingness to develop relationships with clients
- Good and effective time management

title: Account Manager
description:
Job Type: Permanent
Location: Gloucester, Gloucestershire
Hours: 40 hours per week
Competitive Salary & Benefits

The 1,400 people across Hayley Dexis are at the centre of everything we do. By embracing the "Hayley Way" and consistently delivering industry-leading customer service, they play a vital role in our ongoing success.

Do you enjoy building strong customer relationships and turning technical and commercial requirements into solutions that drive business growth and deliver exceptional client outcomes?

We re excited to offer a brilliant opportunity for an Account Manager to be based at our busy and experienced branch in Gloucester.

About the Account Manager role:

You ll be undertaking tasks such as responding to incoming enquiries, responding to customer queries and processing orders. Expect to be on the phone as well as being the face of our trade counter, providing expert knowledge and assistance to any walk-in customers. You ll proactively follow up on outstanding customer enquiries, prepare accurate quotations, and look for opportunities to upsell and add value.

We re looking for someone confident and proactive, who isn t afraid to get stuck into a range of tasks. You ll have prior experience in account management as well as a background in engineering or manufacturing.

What we re looking for in our Account Manager:
- Knowledge of MRO/Engineering products is essential for this role
- Prior account management experience or experience within a customer service / administrative environment.
- Excellent negotiation and communication skills
- Self-motivated, with strong organisational and time-management skills
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment

What you ll get in return:
- From 23 days annual leave (plus public/bank holidays)
- Company car
- Life assurance cover (x 2 salary)
- Invitation to healthcare schemes
- Company pension scheme
- Wellness programmes
- Uniform and PPE provided
- Training and development provided through our own Hayley Academy

What to expect from our recruitment process:
- Initial screening
- Microsoft Teams interview with our Talent Acquisition Advisor
- Face to face interview either in-person or Microsoft Teams
- Decision outcome

We ll close this role on Tuesday 3rd November, but may do so earlier if we receive strong interest so don t miss out.

A final note

Not sure you tick every box? Please don t let that stop you from applying.

Need any reasonable adjustments? Just give our talent acquisition team a shout.

Any questions on your mind? Please reach out to us at (url removed)

title: Business Development Account Manager - Energy & Ut
description:
Business Development Account Manager - Energy & Utilities Sales
Cheltenham Full-time Permanent 37.5 hours per week
Monday - Thursday: 9:00am - 5:30pm Friday: Finish at 3:30pm
£26,000 - £30,000 per annum + Uncapped Commission

Ready for Your Next Move in Energy or B2 B Sales?

We're recruiting three Business Development Account Managers to join a well-established and growing organisation in Cheltenham. This is a great opportunity for someone with a background in energy sales, utilities or B2 B business development who knows how to open doors, build relationships and create genuine commercial opportunities.

Experience within energy or utilities sales would be a particular advantage, including business energy, electricity, gas, energy procurement, brokerage or renewables. If you're commercially driven, confident speaking with decision-makers and motivated by targets and uncapped earning potential, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing
- Prospecting and generating new B2 B opportunities.
- Building relationships with business owners and key decision-makers.
- Understanding client needs and introducing relevant services.
- Qualifying prospects and developing genuine sales opportunities.
- Using telephone, email and LinkedIn to generate new business.
- Managing your sales pipeline and maintaining accurate CRM records.
- Working towards individual and team sales targets.
- Collaborating with the wider sales team to turn opportunities into successful deals.

About You

We're particularly interested in candidates from energy, utilities or commercial B2 B sales backgrounds. You may currently work for an energy supplier, energy broker, utilities consultancy, procurement business or another commercial sales organisation.
You'll ideally have:
- Experience in energy sales, utilities sales, business development, telesales or B2 B account management.
- Confidence speaking with business owners and senior decision-makers.
- Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
- A proactive, resilient and target-driven approach.
- Good organisational and pipeline management skills.
- Experience using CRM systems.
- Energy or utilities experience is highly desirable, but strong B2 B sales professionals from other target-driven sectors are also encouraged to apply.

Your Background Could Include
Energy Sales Consultant, Utilities Sales Consultant, Business Energy Consultant, Energy Broker, Business Development Executive, Business Development Manager, Account Manager, Sales Executive, Telesales Executive, Lead Generator or BDR.
What's On Offer
- £26,000-£30,000 basic salary, depending on experience.
- Uncapped commission with 2% paid on every successful deal you generate.
- Additional performance incentives.
- Clear career progression and ongoing training.
- Early finish every Friday at 3:30pm.
- Profit share opportunities.
- Holiday buy and sell scheme.
- Company pension.
- Employee discounts and rewards.
- Regular company social events.
- Supportive and high-performing team environment.

Interested?

If you're working in energy, utilities or B2 B sales and want uncapped earning potential, progression and a role where your results are rewarded, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply today and a member of the Workforce team will be in touch.
